description: This Java source file defines the LoanInstallmentCharge class, representing a charge associated with a loan installment in the Fineract project. It includes fields for amounts, status flags, and methods for managing charges, payments, waivers, and data conversion.

classes.name: LoanInstallmentCharge
classes.description: Represents a charge applied to a specific loan installment, including amount, status, and methods for payment and waiver management.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this charge's installment number with another's for sorting.

methods.name: copyFrom
methods.description: Copies data from another LoanInstallmentCharge instance.

methods.name: waive
methods.description: Marks the charge as waived, setting amount waived and updating status flags.

methods.name: undoWaive
methods.description: Reverts a waiver, restoring amount outstanding.

methods.name: getAmountWaived
methods.description: Returns the waived amount as Money.

methods.name: getAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the outstanding amount as Money.

methods.name: determineIfFullyPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge is fully paid based on amounts.

methods.name: undoWaive
methods.description: Sets amount outstanding and waived amounts directly.

methods.name: calculateOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates the remaining amount owed on the charge.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the total amount as Money.

methods.name: getAmountPaid
methods.description: Returns the paid amount as Money.

methods.name: calculateAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates outstanding amount based on paid, waived, and written-off amounts.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if the amount outstanding is non-zero.

methods.name: isChargeAmountpaid
methods.description: Checks if the amount paid matches the amount through charge payment.

methods.name: getRepaymentInstallment
methods.description: Returns the associated installment.

methods.name: updatePaidAmountBy
methods.description: Updates the paid amount by a specified increment and fee, adjusting status flags.

methods.name: getAmountWrittenOff
methods.description: Returns the written-off amount as Money.

methods.name: resetPaidAmount
methods.description: Resets the paid amount and updates outstanding.

methods.name: undoWaiveFlag
methods.description: Clears the waived flag.

methods.name: setOutstandingAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount outstanding directly.

methods.name: resetToOriginal
methods.description: Resets all amounts and flags to original state.

methods.name: getAmountThroughChargePayment
methods.description: Returns the amount through charge payment as Money.

methods.name: getUnpaidAmountThroughChargePayment
methods.description: Returns the unpaid portion of the charge payment.

methods.name: updateAmountThroughChargePayment
methods.description: Ensures amount through charge payment does not exceed total amount.

methods.name: updateWaivedAndAmountPaidThroughChargePaymentAmount
methods.description: Updates waived and paid-through-charge-payment amounts.

methods.name: updateWaivedAmount
methods.description: Adjusts waived amount and related flags based on current state.

methods.name: updateInstallment
methods.description: Updates the associated installment.

methods.name: undoPaidAmountBy
methods.description: Reverses a payment amount, updating paid and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: getLoanCharge
methods.description: Returns the associated LoanCharge.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the charge to a data transfer object for external use.
